  • low pressure sensor (for pump to make sure there is a supply of water, kills the pump if pressure is below something like 5psi)
  • first carbon filter (cleans up water as much as possible for the membrane)
  • pump
  • solenoid valve that is normally closed and opens when the pump runs so that there is never RO happening unless the pump is on
  • dissolved solids meter 1 (check what is going into the membrane, meter was cheap)
  • membrane input
  • membrane waste
    • flow limiter that matches the membrane (this keeps pressure on the one side of the membrane and doesn't just let the input water flow to waste)
    • back of toilet, or a drain, or whatever ( recently rant this outside to plants)
  • membrane output
    • dissolved solids meter 2
    • high pressure sensor (tells pump to shut off when tank fills up, typically 60psi, and turn back on at something lower than that, 40psi)
    • Tee
    • Branch 1
      • Storage tank
    • Branch 2
      • Carbon filter (this removes the rubber flavor from the tank which uses a butyl bladder)
      • Output!!!
